author.bio: Pratchett was a British comic novelist and the creator of Discworld. Hogfather is a 1996 entry in that series, mixing fantasy with satire about belief and human behavior.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The sentence belongs to Hogfather’s comic treatment of thinking and foolishness in a magical world. Reading it as a modern prediction about a particular AI system would add a claim the 1996 novel does not make.
